1: package llmverify
2: 
3: import chisel3._
4: import chisel3.util._
5: 
6: object arbit {
7:   // Enum for handshake types
8:   object HandShakeType extends ChiselEnum {
9:     val idle = Value(0.U)
10:     val request = Value(1.U)
11:     val lock = Value(2.U)
12:     val release = Value(3.U)
13:   }
14: }
15: 
16: // Simple model for a processor
17: class procModel extends Module {
18:   import arbit.HandShakeType
19:   
20:   val io = IO(new Bundle {
21:     val ack = Input(Bool())
22:     val req = Output(HandShakeType())
23:   })
24:   
25:   // State register
26:   val procState = RegInit(HandShakeType.idle)
27:   
28:   // Simple counter to simulate non-deterministic choice
29:   val randCounter = RegInit(0.U(3.W))
30:   randCounter := randCounter + 1.U
31:   
32:   // Output assignment
33:   io.req := procState
34:   
35:   // State machine logic
36:   when(procState === HandShakeType.idle && randCounter === 7.U) {
37:     procState := HandShakeType.request
38:   }.elsewhen(procState === HandShakeType.request && io.ack) {
39:     procState := HandShakeType.lock
40:   }.elsewhen(procState === HandShakeType.lock && randCounter > 3.U) {
41:     procState := HandShakeType.release
42:   }.elsewhen(procState === HandShakeType.release) {
43:     procState := HandShakeType.idle
44:   }
45: }
46: 
47: // Arbiter cell module
48: class arbitCell extends Module {
49:   import arbit.HandShakeType
50:   
51:   val io = IO(new Bundle {
52:     val topCell = Input(Bool())
53:     val urLeft = Input(HandShakeType())
54:     val urRight = Input(HandShakeType())
55:     val xa = Input(Bool())
56:     val uaLeft = Output(Bool())
57:     val uaRight = Output(Bool())
58:     val xr = Output(HandShakeType())
59:   })
60:   
61:   // Registers
62:   val prevLeft = RegInit(false.B)
63:   val prevRight = RegInit(true.B)
64:   val processedLeft = RegInit(false.B)
65:   val processedRight = RegInit(false.B)
66:   val holdToken = RegInit(io.topCell) // Initial value depends on topCell
67:   
68:   // Wire definitions
69:   val mustGiveParent = (processedLeft && processedRight && !io.topCell)
70:   val childOwns = (io.urLeft === HandShakeType.lock || io.urRight === HandShakeType.lock)
71:   val giveChild = (io.uaLeft || io.uaRight)
72:   
73:   // Combinational logic for uaLeft
74:   io.uaLeft := (!mustGiveParent && holdToken && (io.urLeft === HandShakeType.request) && 
75:                 (!(io.urRight === HandShakeType.request) || prevRight))
76:   
77:   // Combinational logic for uaRight
78:   io.uaRight := (!mustGiveParent && holdToken && (io.urRight === HandShakeType.request) && 
79:                  (!(io.urLeft === HandShakeType.request) || prevLeft))
80:   
81:   // Combinational logic for xr
82:   when(!holdToken && (io.urLeft === HandShakeType.request || io.urRight === HandShakeType.request)) {
83:     io.xr := HandShakeType.request
84:   }.elsewhen(childOwns) {
85:     io.xr := HandShakeType.lock
86:   }.elsewhen(holdToken && ((mustGiveParent || 
87:                            !(io.urLeft === HandShakeType.request || io.urRight === HandShakeType.request)) && 
88:                            !io.topCell)) {
89:     io.xr := HandShakeType.release
90:   }.otherwise {
91:     io.xr := HandShakeType.idle
92:   }
93:   
94:   // Sequential logic
95:   when(io.xa) {
96:     holdToken := true.B
97:   }.elsewhen(giveChild) {
98:     holdToken := false.B
99:   }.elsewhen(io.urLeft === HandShakeType.release || io.urRight === HandShakeType.release) {
100:     holdToken := true.B
101:   }.elsewhen(io.xr === HandShakeType.release) {
102:     holdToken := false.B
103:   }
104:   
105:   // Update prevLeft and prevRight
106:   when(io.uaLeft) {
107:     prevLeft := true.B
108:     prevRight := false.B
109:   }.elsewhen(io.uaRight) {
110:     prevLeft := false.B
111:     prevRight := true.B
112:   }
113:   
114:   // Update processed flags
115:   when(io.urLeft === HandShakeType.release) {
116:     processedLeft := true.B
117:   }.elsewhen(io.urRight === HandShakeType.release) {
118:     processedRight := true.B
119:   }.elsewhen(processedLeft && processedRight) {
120:     processedLeft := false.B
121:     processedRight := false.B
122:   }
123: }
124:

128:

145:   })
146:

148:   val constTRUE = true.B
149:   val constFALSE = false.B
150:   
151:   // Signals
152:   val ua1 = Wire(Bool())
153:   val ua2 = Wire(Bool())
154:   val ua3 = Wire(Bool())
155:   val ua4 = Wire(Bool())
156:   val xa = Wire(Bool())
157:   val ya = Wire(Bool())
158:   val sa = Wire(Bool())
159:   val ur1 = Wire(HandShakeType())
160:   val ur2 = Wire(HandShakeType())
161:   val ur3 = Wire(HandShakeType())
162:   val ur4 = Wire(HandShakeType())
163:   val xr = Wire(HandShakeType())
164:   val yr = Wire(HandShakeType())
165:   val sr = Wire(HandShakeType())
166:   
167:   sa := constFALSE
168:   
169:   // Instantiate arbitCell C0
170:   val C0 = Module(new arbitCell())
171:   C0.io.topCell := constTRUE
172:   C0.io.urLeft := xr
173:   C0.io.urRight := yr
174:   C0.io.xa := sa  // Fixed: sa is Bool, xa is Bool
175:   xa := C0.io.uaLeft
176:   ya := C0.io.uaRight
177:   sr := C0.io.xr
178:   
179:   // Instantiate arbitCell C1
180:   val C1 = Module(new arbitCell())
181:   C1.io.topCell := constFALSE
182:   C1.io.urLeft := ur1
183:   C1.io.urRight := ur2
184:   C1.io.xa := xa
185:   ua1 := C1.io.uaLeft
186:   ua2 := C1.io.uaRight
187:   xr := C1.io.xr
188:   
189:   // Instantiate arbitCell C2
190:   val C2 = Module(new arbitCell())
191:   C2.io.topCell := constFALSE
192:   C2.io.urLeft := ur3
193:   C2.io.urRight := ur4
194:   C2.io.xa := ya
195:   ua3 := C2.io.uaLeft
196:   ua4 := C2.io.uaRight
197:   yr := C2.io.xr
198:   
199:   // Instantiate procModel P1
200:   val P1 = Module(new procModel())
201:   P1.io.ack := ua1
202:   ur1 := P1.io.req
203:   
204:   // Instantiate procModel P2
205:   val P2 = Module(new procModel())
206:   P2.io.ack := ua2
207:   ur2 := P2.io.req
208:   
209:   // Instantiate procModel P3
210:   val P3 = Module(new procModel())
211:   P3.io.ack := ua3
212:   ur3 := P3.io.req
213:   
214:   // Instantiate procModel P4
215:   val P4 = Module(new procModel())
216:   P4.io.ack := ua4
217:   ur4 := P4.io.req
218:   
219:   // Connect outputs for preservation
220:   io.ua1 := ua1
221:   io.ua2 := ua2
222:   io.ua3 := ua3
223:   io.ua4 := ua4
224:   io.xa := xa
225:   io.ya := ya
226:   io.sa := sa
227:   io.ur1 := ur1
228:   io.ur2 := ur2
229:   io.ur3 := ur3
230:   io.ur4 := ur4
231:   io.xr := xr
232:   io.yr := yr
233:   io.sr := sr
234: }
